integrity: The complete thirty-face complex is embedded. The mod-two first homology quotient is reconstructed from the graph-cycle lattice, every three-vertex clique is exhausted, all sixty simplicial automorphisms are independently enumerated and matched to the published generators, and the induced homology action is checked on every carrier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns mod-two homology and simplicial edge length in one fixed ten-vertex triangulation. It does not classify longer cycles, integral classes, or geometric systoles. Older map-coloring/design references cross-referenced by the later census remain a residual provenance and originality risk because their exact finite computations were not fully inspected.
title: Four \(A_5\)-orbits form the triangular mod-two homology shell of the ten-vertex genus-seven surface
